prose: Best LLM for Every Budget is a daily-updated site that plots blended cost per million tokens (3:1 input:output, log scale) against an Intelligence Index, turning the model frontier into a lookup table: find the row your budget falls in and the pick is the highest-scoring model available at that price, with a runner-up that also fits. A diff view tracks changes between consecutive daily fetches - new models, removed models, and re-scored or re-priced ones - and columns are sortable, with model names linking to their Artificial Analysis pages.
Data comes from the Artificial Analysis free API, fetched daily by a GitHub Actions cron; code and data are published at github.com/terryds/bestvaluemodel.
highlights: Plots blended cost per 1M tokens (3:1 input:output, log scale) against an Intelligence Index.
The frontier as a lookup table: a pick and a runner-up for each budget row.
Daily diffs list new, removed, re-scored and re-priced models.
Sortable columns; model names link to Artificial Analysis.
Data: Artificial Analysis free API, refreshed daily via GitHub Actions cron.
